mergedParams.userDescription: Text revealed by a soft, feathered mask moving vertically. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Soft Feather Mask Vertical Text Reveal

prompts.prompt: Create a typography preset where text is revealed through a soft, feathered vertical mask that moves upward like a theater curtain rising. Think of this as a classic film title reveal where the mask edge has a 40-60px gaussian blur for that dreamy, soft transition. The text should be fully formed but hidden, then gracefully unveiled as the mask travels from bottom to top over 2-3 seconds. Use a BaseLayout container with 'relative overflow-hidden w-full h-full' classes, and position the TextAtom with 'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center'. The mask should be implemented as a gradient overlay div with 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none' that animates its translateY from 0% to -100%. Add a subtle scale effect (0.95 to 1) on the text synchronized with the reveal for added depth. Consider using an internal effect preset for the mask animation that can be reused across multiple text elements.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with TextAtom child and mask overlay div. Use containerProps.className='relative overflow-hidden' for clipping. Implement mask as linear-gradient with transparent-to-black-to-transparent edges using background: 'linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, black 20%, black 80%, transparent 100%)'. Apply CSS mask-image or clip-path with the gradient. Animate using generic effects array with translateY keyframes from 0 to -100 over range [0, 0.8]. Text should use opacity effect from 0.7 to 1 synchronized with mask movement. GPU acceleration via transform: translateZ(0). Timing: ease-out easing for organic motion. Performance: use will-change: transform on mask element.

prompts.prompt: Design a kinetic typography preset that reveals text through multiple soft-edged horizontal strips that slide away vertically in a staggered pattern, like venetian blinds opening. Each strip should have feathered edges (20-30px blur) and move at slightly different speeds to create a cascading reveal effect. Think of editing multiple video tracks with offset timing - each text segment gets its own 'track' in the animation timeline. Use a BaseLayout with 'grid grid-rows-5 gap-0' to create the strip structure. Each strip is a separate BaseLayout with 'overflow-hidden relative' containing a portion of the full TextAtom. Apply staggered delays (0.1s increments) to each strip's animation for the cascade effect. The feathering should be achieved through CSS filter: blur() on pseudo-elements positioned at strip edges.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create BaseLayout grid container with 5 child BaseLayouts using repeatChildrenProps for consistent styling. Each child has containerProps.className='relative overflow-hidden h-full'. Place identical TextAtom in each strip with different clip-path values: polygon(0 20%, 100% 20%, 100% 40%, 0 40%) etc. Add ::before and ::after pseudo-elements via containerProps.style for edge feathering using filter: blur(20px). Animate each strip with generic effects: translateY from 0 to -100vh with staggered startTime values (index * 0.1). Use spring easing for bounce effect. Consider fitDurationTo: 'children' for automatic duration calculation. GPU optimize with transform3d().

prompts.prompt: Build a vertical mask reveal preset where text emerges through a soft, organic wave-like mask that undulates as it moves upward. Imagine editing a water or smoke transition overlay in video software - the mask edge should feel fluid and natural, not geometric. The feathering (blur radius 30-50px) should vary along the mask edge to create an irregular, organic boundary. Use SVG filters for the displacement effect combined with CSS animations. Structure with BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full' containing the TextAtom and an animated SVG mask element. The wave motion should be a combination of vertical translation and horizontal sine-wave distortion. Add subtle text glow that intensifies as each word is revealed, using word-level timing from caption data if available.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with TextAtom and SVG mask overlay. SVG includes feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap filters for organic edge. Animate mask with two effects: translateY (0 to -120%) and custom SVG path morphing for wave motion. If using caption data, apply word-level effects with each word's opacity and text-shadow transitioning based on mask position. CSS: mask-image with radial-gradient for feathering, filter: url(#svgFilter) for distortion. Timing: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for smooth acceleration. Performance: use CSS containment and layer promotion. Consider audio-reactive waveform effects if audio source exists.

prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic text reveal using a soft vertical gradient mask that has multiple feather zones - think of it like a depth-of-field effect in video where different parts of the text come into focus at different rates. The mask should have three distinct blur levels: heavy blur (60px) at the leading edge, medium blur (30px) in the middle transition, and sharp at the revealed area. As the mask moves vertically, text should not only reveal but also animate from blurry to sharp, simulating a focus pull effect. Use BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-sm' and layer multiple TextAtoms with different blur values that crossfade during the reveal. This creates a more sophisticated, production-quality title animation.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Stack 3 TextAtom instances in BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0' positioning. Each has different initial filter: blur() values (20px, 10px, 0px). Use generic effects to animate opacity and blur simultaneously: blurry layer fades out as sharp layer fades in, synchronized with mask position. Mask implemented as div with background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.3) 30%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 60%, black 100%). Animate mask translateY with ease-in-out over range [0.1, 0.9]. Add subtle scale effect (1.05 to 1) for z-axis movement illusion. Performance: use transform: translate3d() and backface-visibility: hidden.

prompts.prompt: Develop a particle-based text reveal where the soft vertical mask appears to dissolve the concealment layer like sand being blown away. The feathered edge (40-50px blur radius) should have animated noise/grain texture that creates a particulate dispersion effect. Think of this as combining a wipe transition with particle effects in video editing. Use BaseLayout containing TextAtom and an overlay with animated CSS grain texture. The mask should move vertically while its edge 'dissolves' through animated SVG turbulence filters. Add micro-animations to individual letters (if using word-level caption data) where they slightly vibrate/shake as the mask passes over them, as if being freed from constraints.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with TextAtom and grain overlay div. Overlay uses CSS background-image with encoded SVG noise pattern, animated via background-position. Apply SVG filter with feTurbulence (baseFrequency animated from 0.02 to 0.08) and feGaussianBlur for edge softness. Mask uses clip-path: polygon() with 8+ points, each animated independently for organic edge. If caption data available, apply word-level shake effect using translateX/Y with small random values as mask approaches. Timing: variable speed using cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). GPU: promote overlay to separate layer. Consider audio-reactive intensity if audio source present.

prompts.prompt: Design a split-screen vertical reveal where text is unveiled through two soft-edged masks moving in opposite directions (one up, one down) that meet in the middle. Like editing a split-screen transition in video software, each half has its own feathered mask (30-40px blur) creating a dreamy curtain effect. The masks should slightly overlap at the center with increased blur (60px) for a seamless blend. Use BaseLayout 'relative' with two mask divs positioned absolutely. TextAtom sits between them. As masks separate, add a subtle light leak effect at the center seam using a white gradient div that flashes briefly. Include letter-spacing animation that contracts as text is revealed, creating a 'coming together' feeling.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout contains TextAtom and two mask divs with 'absolute w-full h-1/2' positioning (top-0 and bottom-0). Each mask has background: linear-gradient with feathered edges using rgba values. Animate top mask translateY from 0 to -100%, bottom mask from 0 to 100% simultaneously. Add center glow div with opacity pulse effect at range [0.4, 0.6]. TextAtom uses letter-spacing effect from 0.2em to 0 over full duration. Apply filter: blur(30px) to mask edges via CSS. Timing: ease-in-out with slight ease-in bias. Performance: use contain: layout style paint.

prompts.prompt: Build an atmospheric text reveal using a soft vertical mask that simulates fog lifting. The mask should have variable feathering (20-80px blur) that changes dynamically as it moves, creating an organic, weather-like reveal. Think of this as color grading and compositing fog elements in post-production. The mask opacity should also vary, being more opaque at bottom (fog is denser) and more transparent at top. Use BaseLayout with multiple layered gradients for depth. Add subtle animation to the text itself - a gentle breathing scale effect (0.98 to 1.02) and slight vertical float. If using caption data, emphasize keyword words with stronger glow effects as they're revealed.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with TextAtom and 3 gradient overlay divs for depth. Each overlay has different blur and opacity values, animated with offset timing. Primary mask: linear-gradient(transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.4) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0.8) 70%, white 100%). Animate translateY with variable speed using custom cubic-bezier. Add CSS backdrop-filter: blur() for glass morphism effect. Text uses combined effects: scale (0.98-1.02 loop) and translateY (subtle float). If caption.words available, apply conditional glow to words where metadata.keyword === true. Performance: use CSS contain and will-change sparingly.

prompts.prompt: Create a glitch-inspired vertical mask reveal where the soft feathered edge (25-35px blur) occasionally distorts and pixelates as it moves. Think of datamoshing or compression artifacts in video editing - the mask should feel digital and unstable. Use BaseLayout with TextAtom and a mask div that has animated CSS filters combining blur, contrast, and hue-rotate. The vertical movement should stutter occasionally (using step() easing for 2-3 frames) to enhance the glitch aesthetic. Add RGB split effect to text at moment of reveal using text-shadow with red/cyan offsets. Include random opacity flickers in the feathered edge area using keyframe animations.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with TextAtom styled with text-shadow for RGB split: '2px 0 #ff00ff, -2px 0 #00ffff'. Mask div uses filter: blur(30px) contrast(1.5) hue-rotate() with animated values. Implement stutter via effects array with specific step() easing at ranges [0.3, 0.35] and [0.7, 0.75]. Add ::before pseudo-element with animated opacity (0-1-0) and pixelated pattern background. Use mix-blend-mode: screen for digital feel. Timing: primarily linear with step() interruptions. GPU: force hardware acceleration with translateZ(0). Consider audio beat sync for glitch timing if audio available.

prompts.prompt: Develop a prismatic text reveal where the vertical mask has a rainbow-gradient feathered edge that refracts light as it passes. Like using a prism filter in video post-production, the mask edge should create chromatic aberration effects. The soft edge (45-55px blur) should separate into color channels (RGB) at slightly different positions. Use BaseLayout with three TextAtom instances, each representing a color channel with blend modes. The mask should be a gradient with color stops that shift hue as it animates vertically. Add subtle lens flare elements at the mask edge using radial gradients. Include a slight warping effect on the text as the mask passes, as if light is bending.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Create 3 TextAtoms with 'absolute inset-0' and mix-blend-mode: screen. Apply color filters: red (filter: hue-rotate(0deg) saturate(2)), green (filter: hue-rotate(120deg)), blue (filter: hue-rotate(240deg)). Offset each by 2-3px vertically. Mask uses conic-gradient with animated hue values. Add lens flare div with radial-gradient and opacity animation synchronized with mask position. Text warping via transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX() with small animated values. Timing: smooth ease-out for organic light behavior. Performance: use transform-style: preserve-3d and limit filter complexity.

prompts.prompt: Design a liquid text reveal where the vertical mask appears as a soft, viscous substance flowing downward while revealing text. The feathered edge (50-70px blur) should undulate and drip irregularly, like editing with fluid simulation plugins. Use SVG filters for realistic liquid distortion - the mask edge should have surface tension effects and occasional drips. BaseLayout should contain TextAtom with an animated SVG mask using morphing paths. The text itself should have a subtle refraction effect as if seen through water, using CSS filters and transforms. Add reflection elements below the text that fade in as revealed, creating a puddle effect.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with TextAtom and SVG mask element. SVG uses animated path with 12+ control points for organic flow. Apply feGaussianBlur (stdDeviation='35') and feDisplacementMap for liquid distortion. Text uses filter: url(#liquidFilter) brightness(1.1) contrast(0.95) for underwater look. Add reflected TextAtom below with 'transform: scaleY(-1) opacity-50' and gradient mask. Animate main mask with morph effect using SMIL or CSS custom properties. Create drip sub-elements with independent gravity-based timing (ease-in). Performance: optimize SVG with reduced path complexity. Consider fitDurationTo for adaptive timing.
